hero.title: If software can solve it, we'll build it.
hero.subtitle: We understand the need, design the solution and build it end to end: business systems, web and mobile apps, integrations, automation and applied AI.
hero.trust: A founding team with 20+ years of combined experience building and leading software for banking, telecom, insurance and other industries.

diagram.label: Diagram: Webuddy connects the systems in your operation and builds apps, dashboards and assistants on top of them.

problems.title: Needs show up as business problems, not technical requirements.
problems.lead: That's why we start by understanding what's happening in your operation. Here are some of the situations we can help with.

solutions.title: One team for the whole cycle: from understanding the problem to evolving the solution.
solutions.lead: We pick the technology for the problem, not the other way around.

process.title: A clear process, with deliverables at every stage.
process.lead: You always know what's being built, why and when.

why.title: What you can expect from us.

items.title: Problem first
items.text: Before proposing technology, we learn how your operation works. What we build has to create efficiency, savings or growth.

items.title: One team, end to end
items.text: Analysis, design, development, QA, deployment and evolution with the same team, no middlemen.

items.title: Engineering with real project management
items.text: We pair software engineering with formal project management, backed by PMP and Scrum training: clear scope, visible priorities and constant communication.

items.title: Nearshore, in your language and time zone
items.text: We work from the Dominican Republic, in English and Spanish, on Atlantic Time (UTC−4): the same as U.S. Eastern in summer and one hour ahead in winter.

capabilities.title: Technology in service of the problem.
capabilities.lead: These are the technologies and practices our team works with. We choose each one based on what the project needs.
capabilities.note: Already have a tech stack? Tell us what it is and we will assess how to work with it.

cta.title: Tell us what you need to solve.
cta.text: A first conversation, with no commitment, to understand your need and propose the next step.

solutionsPage.title: We start from the problem, not the format.
solutionsPage.lead: We don't arrive with a predefined solution. These are the ways we usually help companies, and many projects combine several.
solutionsPage.entryText: Start with Discovery: together we define the problem, the solution and the plan before building.
solutionsPage.comboText: That is the most common scenario: an internal system with integrations, or a product with automation. Tell us what you need and we will propose an approach.

solution.ctaText: Tell us about your situation and we'll propose the next step.

work.title: What we've built, and the experience behind it.
work.lead: Here you'll find projects delivered by Webuddy and, listed separately, projects our partners delivered before founding the company.

howWeWork.title: A clear process, so you know what's being built, why and when.
howWeWork.lead: We combine software engineering with project management. Every stage has concrete deliverables and clear decision points for you.

models.title: We adapt to how you need to work.

items.title: Fixed-scope project
items.text: For initiatives with clear goals. Scope, plan, deliverables and budget agreed up front.
items.best: Best for new systems, MVPs and specific integrations.

items.title: Dedicated team
items.text: A Webuddy team embedded in your operation, with the capacity your roadmap needs and priorities you set.
items.best: Best for products in constant evolution and companies without an in-house tech team.

items.title: Ongoing evolution & support
items.text: Maintenance, improvements and support for production systems, with agreed priorities and response times.
items.best: Best for critical systems and platforms that need to keep growing.

principles.title: The rules we follow on every project.

items.title: Full visibility
items.text: A shared project board, demoable progress and regular check-ins.

items.title: Quality from day one
items.text: QA and testing are part of every release, not the end of the project.

items.title: Formal management
items.text: Scope, risks and changes managed with PMP and Scrum practices.

items.title: One point of contact
items.text: A single project lead, in English or Spanish.

items.title: Documentation and handover
items.text: We document what we build so your team can run it and evolve it.

items.q: How much does a custom software project cost?
items.a: It depends on scope, complexity and integrations. That's why we start by understanding the need: after a first conversation we can give you a range, and after Discovery, a detailed estimate.

items.q: Do you work with companies outside the Dominican Republic?
items.a: Yes. We work remotely, in English and Spanish, during hours that overlap with U.S. time zones.
Yes. We can sign a non-disclosure agreement before you share the details of your project.

items.q: How do you handle scope changes?
items.a: Changes are normal in any project. We assess them with you, estimate their impact on time and cost, and you decide how to prioritize them.
We can continue with an evolution and support plan, or hand everything over to your team with the documentation it needs.

about.title: Software engineering with a business mindset.
about.lead: Webuddy was founded with a clear vision: to make technology accessible, strategic and useful for real businesses. We bring together software engineering and project leadership to understand each business and build the software it actually needs.

story.title: Born in the Dominican Republic. Building for the world.
story.p1: We don't believe in building unnecessary systems or overcomplicating processes with jargon. We believe in understanding how a business works and designing solutions that drive its growth.
story.p2: Our partners have spent more than a decade building and leading software for companies in banking, telecom, insurance, hospitality, consumer goods and real estate. Webuddy brings that experience together in one team, serving companies of every size, in the Dominican Republic and beyond.
